newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka congratulates China on Hong Kong takeover.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka congratulates China on Hong Kong takeover.

text.p: Sri Lanka said on Monday it was confident that the resumption of Chinese rule over Hong Kong would bode well for both Beijing and the British colony.

"All Sri Lankans welcome this resumption of China's sovereignty over that territory, in the confident expectation that it cannot but accrue to enhanced well-being of both China and Hong Kong," President Chandrika Bandaranaike Kumaratunga said in a message to her Chinese counterpart, Jiang Zemin.
Kumaratunga called Hong Kong's transfer to Chinese rule an "auspicious and memorable occasion", and said she wished for the continuing well-being and prosperity of the territory as part of China.
Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule at midnight on Monday after 156 years of British rule.
